current.text: Verify that, if the application supports multiple identity providers (IdPs), the user's identity cannot be spoofed via another supported identity provider (eg. by using the same user identifier). The standard mitigation would be for the application to register and identify the user using a combination of the IdP ID (serving as a namespace) and the user's ID in the IdP.

summaries.body: The 5.0.0 mapping lists V6.8.1 as ADDED, with no 4.0.3 predecessor. The clause addresses identity spoofing when an application supports multiple identity providers: a user must not be confused with another IdP's user who shares the same identifier. The attested mitigation is to register users as the pair (IdP ID as namespace, user ID in that IdP). Mapping is the origin of this federation control.

No supplied commit or issue records how this wording was drafted. Git events in the slot (cryptography #537, V11.1.4 anti-automation merge, access-control file edits) are other chapters after ID-slot reuse. There is no attested evolution beyond ADDED.
